messages:
Jamal: Quick heads-up — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/5123 needs a second approver before the 18:00 UTC cutoff. CI is mostly green but one flaky integration failed. Can someone spare a quick review? @Maria @Alex :eyes:

Maria: I'll take a look now. do we need a full pass or just approve-if-small?

Jamal: small change — drops a debug printf and adds a quick unit test. main thing is to confirm the test is acceptable and the extra log removed.

release-bot: CI re-run triggered for PR #5123 (requested by Jamal). Jobs queued: unit-1, unit-2, integ-1

Alex: glancing — the unit test looks fine. small nit: prefer using testutil.MockStore instead of the real fixture. will comment inline.

Maria: saw the inline. Jamal, can you swap to MockStore? If yes, I can give an approve after that.

Jamal: yep will push a tiny change in 2–3m.

release-bot: CI update: unit-1 passed, unit-2 passed, integ-1 failed (timeout).

Sue: fwiw integ-1 has been flaky today — might be infrastructure. if you re-run integ it usually passes.

Jamal: re-run integ started by release-bot. also pushed the MockStore tweak and squashed the debug log.

Alex: thanks — LGTM after the MockStore change. leaving the approve now. :thumbsup:

Maria: running the last CI and smoke locally — if green I'll drop an approve too.

release-bot: CI update: integ-1 passed. All checks green.

Maria: LGTM. Approving now. :white_check_mark:

Jamal: great — that makes 2 approves. merging in the merge window. will wait 5m to ensure no late CI flake.

oncall-sheriff: noted. I'll watch the canary after merge (watchlist: latency, error-rate). rollback plan: revert cherry-pick back to main and re-deploy previous release if we see sustained regression > 5 minutes.

Jamal: merging in 30s. thanks everyone. ping here if anything odd shows up in dashboards.

release-bot: Merge performed for PR #5123 by Jamal at 1766654550. Canary rollout started.

Alex: monitoring dashboards — initial 2 minutes look fine. will keep an eye for the 10m window. :eyes:

Sue: great job getting the second eye so fast. saved the cutoff. :tada:
